title: PeerDrop
description: Whether PeerDrop works for the people using it: the site, clients online, connections between peers and their route, transfers, the TURN relay, then the backend and its pods. Connection and transfer counts come from the browsers. One peer reports each connection, the sender reports each file.

links.title: Fleet overview
links.tooltip: Start page: every host, service and signal at a glance

links.title: Edge traffic for peerdrop
links.tooltip: Requests to the site and the backend, with their clients

list.name: Argo CD syncs
list.expr: sum by (name, phase) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false"}[2m])) > 0 unless on (name) sum by (name) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false"}[1h])) > 6

list.name: Host rebuilds
list.expr: max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds) unless max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds offset 15m)

panels.title: peerdrop.de
panels.description: Whether the probe got a 2xx answer from https://peerdrop.de in the last five minutes.

panels.title: Clients online
panels.description: Browser tabs with an open WebSocket to the backend.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Peer pairs the backend told to connect in the selected range.

panels.title: Connection success
panels.description: Share of peer connections that connected. The rest found no working network path.

panels.title: Over relay
panels.description: Share of connected peers whose traffic runs through a TURN server.

panels.title: Transfer success
panels.description: Share of ended file transfers that the receiver confirmed.

panels.title: Files sent
panels.description: Files whose transfer ended in the selected range, confirmed or not.

panels.title: Data sent
panels.description: Bytes that left senders in the selected range.

panels.title: Data over relay
panels.description: Bytes sent through a TURN server. The relay carries each byte twice, once in and once out.

panels.title: Setup time
panels.description: Median time from opening the peer connection to connected.

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Registered accounts.

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Devices registered with at least one account.

panels.title: Clients online
panels.description: Browser tabs with an open WebSocket, by whether the tab is signed in.

panels.title: Connection requests
panels.description: Requests by token per hour and the answers to them. A request to a token that nobody holds bounces (unknown_token). Quick connects to an own device send no request.

panels.title: Peer connections by route
panels.description: Connections per hour. host: both peers on local addresses. reflexive: at least one peer behind NAT. relay: at least one peer sends through TURN.

panels.title: Connections started by path
panels.description: Connections per hour. token: an accepted request, from the network list or a typed token. account: a quick connect to a device of the same account.

panels.title: Files
panels.description: Ended file transfers per hour. A transfer counts as failed when its channel closes before the receiver confirms.

panels.title: Data sent by route
panels.description: Bytes per hour that left senders, by route.

panels.title: Connection setup time
panels.description: Time from opening the peer connection to connected, over the past hour at each point.

panels.title: Allocations
panels.description: Relay addresses that coturn holds for browsers, by the transport between browser and relay. A browser allocates once per TURN URL, so one relayed connection holds several.

panels.title: Data relayed
panels.description: Bytes per hour between browsers and coturn. coturn counts an allocation's bytes once it ends.

panels.title: Rejected credentials
panels.description: Requests per hour that coturn refused, by cause. expired: a credential past its 24 hours. integrity_mismatch: a credential not signed with the shared secret.

panels.title: Relay certificate
panels.description: Days until the certificate of turn.peerdrop.de expires. cert-manager renews it 30 days ahead.

panels.title: Requests by route
panels.description: HTTP requests per second that the backend answered, by route and status. A WebSocket (/connect) counts once when it closes.

panels.title: Latency p95 by route
panels.description: 95th percentile duration per route. The WebSocket (/connect) lasts as long as its tab and stays out.

panels.title: Edge requests
panels.description: Requests per second through the Gateway to frontend and backend, by status. Counted by Hubble.

panels.title: Site probe
panels.description: Time the probe takes for a full GET of https://peerdrop.de.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores in use per pod.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set per pod against its limit. A container that reaches the limit gets killed.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts in the selected range.

panels.title: Certificate
panels.description: Days until the certificate of peerdrop.de expires. cert-manager renews it 30 days ahead.

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: Lines at warning level and above from every PeerDrop container, newest first.

targets.expr: k8s.namespace.name:=peerdrop severity_number:>=13 | copy severity_text as level

panels.title: Backend
panels.description: Every backend log line, newest first.

targets.expr: k8s.namespace.name:=peerdrop k8s.container.name:=peerdrop-backend | copy severity_text as level

panels.title: Relay
panels.description: Every coturn log line, newest first. Scanners probing 443 and 3478 leave socket errors here.

targets.expr: k8s.namespace.name:=turn k8s.container.name:=coturn | copy severity_text as level
